Objects on desk: In the center sits an open silver MacBook laptop. To the left is an empty shopping bag, a mirror/clock, a blue container labeled 'ホルム', an angled laptop riser, and tangled cables. To the right lies a blue optical mouse on a yellow microfiber cloth and small desk containers.
Screen content: The laptop displays WeChat Read (weread.qq.com) in dark mode reading the e-book '能量, 性, 自杀_线粒体与生命的意义', displaying text comparing Neisseria gonorrhoeae to primitive mitochondria and detailing the PorB pore-forming protein.
text_visible: 能量, 性, 自杀_线粒体与生命的意义
弗雷德和迈克利迪斯将导致淋病这一性传播疾病的现代细菌——淋球菌（Neisseria gonorrhoeae）——的行为和早期真核细胞合并体中原始线粒体的可能行为作了比较。淋球菌与白细胞一起感染尿道和宫颈细胞，一旦进入这些细胞，淋球菌就会表现出一种邪恶的狡猾。这种细菌产生一种名为PorB的成孔蛋白（类似于线粒体的bcl-2蛋白）。
PorB蛋白被插入宿主细胞膜，以及细胞内包裹着细菌的液泡膜上。
segments.details: My gaze focuses on the upper sentences describing the comparison between Neisseria gonorrhoeae and primitive mitochondria.
